hypotheses.justification: The library proves this outright. `ModularCurve.heckeOperatorsCommuteBar (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] : ModularCurve.HeckeOperatorsCommuteBar N` is in Theorems/Thm_ModularCurve_heckeOperatorsCommuteBar.lean. Its proof is `solution` in P2M/Sol/S_ModularCurve_heckeOperatorsCommuteBar.lean, and a search of that file found no sorry or axiom. It needs only `[NeZero M]`, which the theorem already takes. `hcomm` appears in no other binder and not in the conclusion, so deleting it leaves the statement unchanged. The proof uses it only in `heckeModuleBar_heckeGen_smul hcomm ⟨p, Fact.out⟩ x`, which can take `ModularCurve.heckeOperatorsCommuteBar M` instead. The library already does this, for example in `reductionModL_heckeOperatorBar` in P2M/Sol/S_ModularCurve_JZeroNeronObjectAtP_abq_heckeGen_smul_of_forall_reductionModL_eq.lean. There is no degenerate case to check, because the fact holds for every M with NeZero M.
